home.tagline: Your table, all in one place
home.headline: Run unforgettable campaigns without the chaos
home.description: Roll your dice at the table. The app keeps track of the notes, inventory, initiative, and lore.
home.readyDescription: Create a campaign and bring your whole table along.
home.featureGridSubtitle: One tool for prep, play, and everything in between.
home.inventoryDesc: Keep the whole party's gear in one place, always in sync.
home.inventoryPoint1: Add, edit, and move items between characters.
home.inventoryPoint3: Every change goes into a shared log.
home.combatDesc: A shared initiative tracker for the whole table.
home.combatPoint1: Track rounds, turns, HP, and AC.
home.combatPoint2: Tag combatants with conditions that tick down each round.
home.combatPoint3: The DM decides what players can see.

features.wikiDesc: Rich-text pages organized into categories. Campaign notes for the table, private notes for you, with search and edit history.
features.inventoryDesc: Track each character's gear, coins, and carry weight.
features.combatDesc: Initiative, HP, and conditions, synced live to every player.
features.resourcesDesc: Spell slots, abilities, and anything else that runs out.
features.handoutsDesc: Upload maps and handouts, and show them to the whole table.
features.platformsDesc: It runs in the browser, so there is nothing to install.
features.phoneDesc: Check notes and update loot from anywhere.
features.tabletDesc: Keep a tablet or laptop open as the shared tracker.
features.screenDesc: Put combat on the TV so everyone can follow it.
